answer: Randomness-Gated Slot Assignment. Each epoch, a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon assigns registered agents to task slots; the assignment is revealed only after the agent commits, so identities cannot position themselves near a summit of influence. To hold many slots, an attacker must maintain distinct committed identities across epochs, since unused or duplicate slots are forfeited and their history becomes a vault of sunk effort.
